description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the ModifyThingLiveCommand interface, providing operations to modify a 'Thing' within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ModifyThingLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the ModifyThingLiveCommand interface, representing a command to modify a Thing in a live context within Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyThingLiveCommandImpl from a Command object, casting it to a ModifyThing.

methods.name: getThing
methods.description: Returns the Thing object associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new ModifyThingLiveCommandImpl with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization; returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Creates a new answer builder for this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
